mentions.name: kiosk24
mentions.description: This service takes hourly visual snapshots of the front pages of selected news websites so they can be tracked over time. It is self-hosted, with the agent running on a Raspberry Pi 5.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I working on a service[1] for myself to track visually the first page of some news websites hourly. Hosting the agent on my RP5.

[1]https://kiosk24.site
